github.method: repo source truth, issues, pull requests, code and docs coordination

google_drive.method: source documents, business plans, dashboards, Xyla handoff sheets, and workbook intelligence
google_drive.write_rule: write only after explicit approval for canon changes

supabase.method: runtime telemetry, bridge queues, approvals, evidence, blockers, social draft state
supabase.write_rule: no schema or production data mutation without approval

vercel.method: cron triggers and hosted Auto Builder runtime routes
vercel.cron_expectation: social bridge and recursive control may run every 5 minutes as triggers, not uncontrolled workers

metricool.method: planning, timing, analytics, and draft social scheduling
metricool.publish_rule: draft-only by default; public posting requires approval

xyla.method: autoposting and content feed using approved Epoxy Will Change Your Life source content
xyla.publish_rule: only approved content may move from draft to public

shopify.method: lead capture, free starter pack, products, bundles, and sales conversion
shopify.write_rule: no product, collection, discount, theme, payment, or live store mutation without approval

heygen_runway_descript_invideo.method: avatar video, cinematic image/video, repurposing, edits, and campaign-ready clips

automation_lanes.purpose: collect approved sources from Drive, GitHub, Shopify, Xyla, Metricool, and Supabase
turn source material into campaign packets, content calendars, and task queues
create scripts, captions, shot lists, image briefs, avatar prompts, and ad variants
route approved drafts into Metricool, Xyla, Shopify landing paths, or content planner queues
score daily posts, identify winners, clone strongest hooks and formats
block unsafe, unapproved, unverified, external, or high-risk actions

growth_target.core_method: high-volume content testing, creator leverage, paid winner amplification, retargeting, and weekly winner cloning
growth_target.forbidden_method: fake followers, fake likes, fake views, bot comments, or platform evasion

measurement_thresholds.kill: low retention, low watch time, low shares, no profile movement after first test window
measurement_thresholds.improve: moderate watch time or saves but weak follow-through
measurement_thresholds.clone: high retention, high saves or shares, follower conversion, comments, or Shopify clicks
